description: Return everything the Aeroz agent has built for this organisation: the regulatory calendar with only ADOPTED dates, the passport scaffold per product showing exactly which fields are missing, the identifier audit, the GS1 route, monitoring coverage, integration readiness, and the pre-filled audit scope. Each block carries a confidence — `computed` is derived from this account's own data and needs no review; `sourced` and `drafted` came from outside the platform or involved judgement and are cited. Use this to answer almost any question about what this business needs to do. Report a block's confidence when you rely on it, and never present a `drafted` block as settled.
